layers.process: Nyungwe canopy walkway (160 m long, 70 m high; reached by the guided Igishigishigi trail or the Imbaraga and Umuyove hiking trails): international visitor USD 40 (about A$56.82); foreign resident in Rwanda or EAC USD 20; Rwandan or EAC citizen USD 5. (A$ at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040.)

Nyungwe chimpanzee tracking: permits can be booked online, at an RDB office or through a tour operator. Tracking starts at 5.30 am and visitors spend a maximum of one hour with the chimps once found. The page gives no fee.
